paite: TOUPA aw, kumpipa tuh na hatna ah anuam ding a, na hotdamna ah nuamsa na zouzen in chia!
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding, David La / Vualzohna Ziak A Kipahthu Genna
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!

paite: Alungtang deihlam na pia a, amuk a thilnget na phal lou kei hi. Selah
english: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.

paite: Hoihna a vualzohnate in na dawn a; dangka-eng siangthou kumpi lukhu na khusak hi.
english: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.

paite: Ama'n hinna ahon ngen a, na pia a tangtawn tangtawn a damna.
english: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

paite: Na hotdamna ah athupina alian mahmah ahi; pahtawina leh thupina amah tung ah na nga zel hi.
english: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.

paite: Tangtawn a ding in vualzawlna liantak mu in na bawl a, na ma a nopsakna in na kipaksak hi.
english: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

paite: Kumpipa'n TOUPA amuang a, tungnungpen zahngaihna ziak in aling kei ding hi.
english: For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.

paite: Na khut in na melmate tengteng azongkhe vek ding a; na khut taklam in nang hon doute azongkhe ding hi.
english: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

paite: Na heh hun chiang in amau haltuina meikuang lutlut bang in na bawl ding. TOUPA'N amau heh in avalh khin ding a, mei in akangmang mai ding hi.
english: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.

paite: Agahte uh lei a kipan na hihmang ding a, asuante uh mihing tate lak a kipan in na hihmang behlap ding hi.
english: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.

paite: Na tung ah thil gilou hih atum ua; thil gilou angaihtuahkhia ua, ahihtangtung thei ngal kei uhi.
english: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.

paite: Nang amau na kiheisak dek a, na thalpeu khaute amaitang uah laisa in na bawl ding hi.
english: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.

paite: TOUPA aw, na hatna ah pahtawi in hong om in, huchi in na thilhihtheihna phat in la ka sa ding uhi.
english: Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
